notes.title: Playtest Demo Available
notes.notes:
The playtest demo is available to download for free on the[url=https://discord.gg/8yPGaNwCMY] Lockstone Mountains Discord[/url]!

The demo features :
-Three arenas with differing enemies and rewards
-A large cluster to explore with resources pickups and roaming enemies
-17 Upgrades
-6 Hulls
-12 Weapons
-4 Mobility Stations
-7 Enemy types
-Saving/Loading + autosaves

With more to come in later demo versions, depending on feedback
-More weapons, hulls and stations
-Scouting hangar to explore clusters
-Lore-giving pickups
-Boss fights
-controller support
